{"c": "The stub and tests are clear. Writing the implementation:", "r": "A simple task. Implement LRUCache using OrderedDict. Key points:

- capacity < 1 → ValueError
- ttl=None → no expiration
- Entries expire when clock() >= t + ttl
- get: returns the value on a hit, moves to the end (most recently used); deletes expired ones; returns default on miss/expired
- put: first delete expired entries, then insert/update, move to the end, evict LRU until size <= capacity
- len: only live entries (need to sweep out expired ones)
- in: live check, doesn't touch recency (access order)

Note: test_expired_dropped_before_evicting_live — capacity 2, ttl 5. Put old at t=0 (expires at 5). At t=4, put live (expires at 9). At t=6, put new: first delete expired → delete old. After that the dict has live + new = 2 <= capacity. Good.

Edge case: put on an existing key — first delete expired entries, then insert. Note that even if the key itself is expired, deletion removes it, so no problem.

Implementation using OrderedDict:

```python
import time
from collections import OrderedDict

class LRUCache:
    def __init__(self, capacity, ttl=None, clock=time.monotonic):
        if capacity < 1:
            raise ValueError("capacity must be >= 1")
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self.clock = clock
        self._data = OrderedDict()  # key -> (value, expires_at or None)

    def _expired(self, expires_at, now):
        return self.ttl is not None and now >= expires_at

    def _purge(self, now=None):
        if self.ttl is None:
            return
        if now is None:
            now = self.clock()
        expired = [k for k, (_, exp) in self._data.items() if now >= exp]
        for k in expired:
            del self._data[k]

    def get(self, key, default=None):
        if self.ttl is not None:
            now = self.clock()
            entry = self._data.get(key)
            if entry is not None and now >= entry[1]:
                del self._data[key]
                return default
        else:
            entry = self._data.get(key)
        if entry is None:
            return default
        self._data.move_to_end(key)
        return entry[0]

    def put(self, key, value):
        now = self.clock() if self.ttl is not None else None
        self._purge(now)
        exp = None if self.ttl is None else now + self.ttl
        self._data[key] = (value, exp)
        self._data.move_to_end(key)
        while len(self._data) > self.capacity:
            self._data.popitem(last=False)

    def __len__(self):
        self._purge()
        return len(self._data)

    def __contains__(self, key):
        entry = self._data.get(key)
        if entry is None:
            return False
        if self.ttl is not None and self.clock() >= entry[1]:
            del self._data[key]  # delete the expired one
            return False
        return True
```

Note: __contains__ — the spec says "key in cache is True only for live entries and doesn't change recency." Whether to delete expired ones isn't specified; deleting is fine and is consistent with the lazy deletion policy.

An entry is expired once ``clock() >= expires_at``;\n    expired entries are dropped lazily on access.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, capacity, ttl=None, clock=time.monotonic):\n        if capacity < 1:\n            raise ValueError(\"capacity must be at least 1\")\n        self.capacity = capacity\n        self.ttl = ttl\n        self.clock = clock\n        self._data = OrderedDict()  # key -> (value, expires_at or None)\n\n    def _purge_expired(self, now):\n        for key in [k for k, (_, exp) in self._data.items() if now >= exp]:\n            del self._data[key]\n\n    def get(self, key, default=None):\n        entry = self._data.get(key)\n        if entry is None:\n            return default\n        if self.ttl is not None and self.clock() >= entry[1]:\n            del self._data[key]\n            return default\n        self._data.move_to_end(key)\n        return entry[0]\n\n    def put(self, key, value):\n        if self.ttl is None:\n            self._data[key] = (value, None)\n        else:\n            now = self.clock()\n            self._purge_expired(now)\n            self._data[key] = (value, now + self.ttl)\n        self._data.move_to_end(key)\n        while len(self._data) > self.capacity:\n            self._data.popitem(last=False)\n\n    def __len__(self):\n        if self.ttl is not None:\n            self._purge_expired(self.clock())\n        return len(self._data)\n\n    def __contains__(self, key):\n        entry = self._data.get(key)\n        if entry is None:\n            return False\n        if self.ttl is not None and self.clock() >= entry[1]:\n            del self._data[key]\n            return False\n        return True\n"}"]]}
